title: api: improve rate-limit semantics, idempotency, and retry-after for OpenAI-compat layer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: We observed inconsistent rate-limit responses and retry semantics from the OpenAI-compat layer which led to client confusion and brittle SDK retries (INCIDENT SUP-1284). This PR standardizes rate-limit headers (Retry-After in seconds), introduces canonical error codes for rate limit / quota / idempotency failures, and improves idempotency key handling for non-idempotent endpoints (streaming & function calls).

What this PR does: consolidates rate-limit enforcement in pkg/api/ratelimit.go; adds consistent Retry-After header generation for burst vs sustained limits; surfaces a strong error envelope for OpenAI-compat responses (type/error_code/message/param) to match our SDKs' expectations; validates and stores idempotency keys for request dedup in pkg/idempotency/store (in-memory + Redis fallback); makes streaming endpoints tolerant to transient 429s by emitting a stable error frame and allowing client-side reconnect with the same idempotency key; updates SDK compat layer to parse our new error envelope.

Compatibility notes: The OpenAI-compat endpoints retain backward-compatible status codes (429 for rate limit) but now include structured JSON with a "type" and "code" fields (e.g., type: "rate_limit", code: "rate_limit.exceeded"), and a Retry-After header in seconds. SDKs should rely on the error.code and Retry-After header for backoff logic. Existing clients that only check HTTP status continue to work but will benefit from improved guidance in headers and body.

Files changed (high level): pkg/api/ratelimit.go - centralize parsing/enforcement and header generation; pkg/http/handler_openai_compat.go - map internal errors to compat envelope; pkg/streaming/stream_manager.go - add error-frame semantics for 429 and idempotency handling; pkg/idempotency/store.go - implement Redis-backed dedupe + TTL behavior; sdk/python/openai_compat.py - parse new envelope and surface retry_after_seconds utility; docs/openai-compat.md - document new error envelope and rate-limit semantics; test/integ/ratelimit_test.go - new integration tests for sustained vs burst limits.

Checklist: [x] Unit tests added/updated; [x] Integration tests for rate-limit/retry semantics; [x] Docs updated; [x] SDK parsing update included; [x] SRE review for rollout plan.

Testing and rollout: Unit and integration tests run in CI. Staged rollout on dedicated clusters for 48 hours with traffic mirroring before full rollout. SRE will maintain a temporary increased alert threshold for 429 increase during rollout.

Related: references ENG-4126, SUP-1284 for incident context and ENG-4190 for idempotency design doc.
